notes.title: ILLAMAN X PITCH 92 - Live in The Blueprint
notes.content:
Jump in! Experience live music in-game as real artists are beamed into The Blueprint in 3D. 

Hip hop duo ILLAMAN and PITCH 92 are stepping into our virtual venue on Thursday 26 October for a live performance from 8pm BST (doors open 7.45pm BST). 

Head in and you'll be able to join the online event as an avatar and explore The Blueprint - our virtual warehouse. The artists can see your avatars in the venue! So be sure to mash those emotes and you might get a shout out. 

Get your free tickets here

Make sure to join our Discord server too. Here you can send messages to Illaman and Pitch 92 during the performance and chat to other fans!

ABOUT THE ARTISTS
Illaman has a cult following across the globe and now fronts the immense punk/grime outfit Pengshui. Illa has toured with heavyweight acts such as Goldie, Foreign Beggars and Andy C with his appearances spanning many scenes and imprints. But his pair of EPs with Norm Oddity (Give Us A Smile and Ugly Days) exhibit his signature, free-flowing introspection. 

Producer Pitch 92 moved from Dublin to Manchester, by way of Germany and Switzerland, with Madlib and Dilla on loop. He and his MPC joined The Mouse Outfit in 2009, with his jazzy boom-bap becoming the nucleus of their iconic, first two albums. Seven years later, he left to pursue a solo career at High Focus Records. Pitch now sits on multiple albums with Verb T, as well as feature-stacked projects Lost In Space, 3rd Culture and Intervals.

ABOUT PHONETIC 
Phonetic is an artist who is already synonymous with Brighton’s thriving hip hop scene, thanks to her skills on the mic, combined with her unwavering creative drive. That drive and talent go way beyond her 25 years and they are good signifiers as to why she has already earned support slots for a number of notable artists and acts, including Rag’N’Bone Man, Children of Zeus, Skinnyman, LEVELZ, High Focus, Amy True & more!

notes.title: Verb T LIVE in The Blueprint
notes.content:
Jump into The Blueprint on Thursday 28 September 8PM BST for a LIVE performance from one of the UK's leading figures in hip hop, VERB T.

Verb T will be streamed live in 3D into our virtual warehouse! You'll be able to join online as an avatar and experience the performance from wherever you are.

Grab your free tickets here

Make sure to join our Discord server too. Here you can send messages to Verb T during the performance and chat to other fans!

ABOUT VERB T
Verb T is one of the UK's leading figures in hip hop music. From being plucked at a young age by the ground breaking Low Life Records, to releasing albums on the well respected YNR imprint, Verb T is now being championed as one of the top artists on High Focus Records. He is a key member of one of the most successful crews to emerge out of the UK - The Four Owls - and has recently worked with living legend DJ Premier. Verb T is one of the most highly decorated artists in UK hip hop and has consistently maintained his position at the top of the pile.

ABOUT TRUEMENDOUS
Described as “one to watch out for” by Akil The MC from Jurassic 5, lyricist TrueMendous is arguably one of the best upcoming artists in the UK. Her music transcends multiple genres, including hip hop, neo-soul, pop and jazz. Signed to High Focus Records, TrueMendous has performed at Glastonbury, Reading and Leeds Festival and Boomtown to name a few. Her singles have been played on BBC Radio 1 and BBC1Xtra and most recently, she performed the opening track for the Women's FA Cup final at Wembley Stadium to a world record audience for women's football, aired on BBC 1.

Grab your free tickets here

ABOUT COOPS
Not many rappers can boast that their first ever live performance was at London's O2 Arena, supporting hip hop legend, Nas. Such was the talent of Coops, who at 23-years-old won Choice FM's Breakthrough Competition, and the chance to perform alongside one of his formative influences. “I want to be inspired by the greats, rather than what's current,” the North Londoner explains, citing Jay Z, A Tribe Called Quest and Eminem as other major inspirations. Coops signed to High Focus Records in 2017 and hasn't looked back since.

ABOUT JMAN
London born rapper with roots in Jamaica, Jman is known for his multi faceted style, explosive energy and unmatched live shows. Jman has toured the world with acts such as DJ Vadim, Mungo’s Hi Fi and Gentleman’s Dub Club. He has released 5 solo LPs, signed to hip hop label High Focus Records with his full live band “The Argonautz” and to Real Life Drama Records as “Babylon Dead”. Jman isn’t stopping any time soon. Don't miss your chance to catch him performing live in The Blueprint this September.
